text: Just thinking: We believe Donald J Trump is in the business of drug dealing. Do you believe it or not? It is big money through out the US of A. The reason for this statement is who D J Trump pardoned form prison who have been convicted for violent to major drug kingpins prison time. Example: Ross Ulbricht: The founder of the dark web marketplace Silk Road, which facilitated the sale of over $214 million in illegal drugs and other illicit goods, received a full pardon in January 2025 during Trump's second term in office. Ulbricht had been serving a double life sentence plus 40 years. Juan Orlando Hernández: The former president of Honduras was sentenced to 45 years in prison for helping to move at least 400 tons of cocaine into the U.S., effectively running the country as a "narco-state." Trump pardoned him in December 2025. Larry Hoover: A Chicago gang leader and founder of the Gangster Disciples, who was serving six life sentences on federal drug and racketeering charges, had his sentence commuted in May 2025.
